name: smwmusic-mitsume-ga-tooru-boss-theme
title: Mitsume ga Tooru - Boss Theme
description:
Sampled arrangement of this fast-paced chiptune which comes from the obscure NES game Mitsume ga Tooru. Mostly useful for boss battles, though it might fit into some space or factory-themed levels aswell.

Requested by TheMorganah; Also thanks to Ultima for providing me the lead sample.
